method: 300 x 300 px full-resolution crops (LOC IIIF region requests, cw0325000a) centred on each predicted crossing (sheet-a registration); the drawn symbol was looked for by eye within the crop (about +-75 m); images in tmp/b1863/roads/hi (not committed). The distance between the predicted crossing and the drawn symbol reflects the registration error (15-50 m), so the symbol confirms the type, not the exact position.
